_meta.data_freshness: Program existence, type, chain/ecosystem, region, and dilution posture are evergreen and verified through June 2026. TIME-SENSITIVE fields (application deadlines, open/closed cohort status, current prize pool / check size, cadence) are baseline snapshots and MUST be re-verified live before the user applies or acts.
_meta.coverage: Global. Every entry is region-tagged. Southeast Asia / Vietnam-relevant entries carry sea_relevant: true.

opportunities.name: a16z Crypto Startup Accelerator (CSX)
opportunities.notes: Intensive multi-week program from a16z crypto. Network-heavy, founder-friendly. Check the official page for the next cohort window.

opportunities.name: Alliance DAO
opportunities.notes: Application deadline July 22 for cohort ALL18 (starts Sep 7, 2026). Famously selective alumni. Strong web3-native network.

opportunities.name: Outlier Ventures Base Camp
opportunities.notes: Often called the "YC of Web3"; 300+ startups accelerated. "Post-Web" thesis (internet for humans and machines). Token-launch and go-to-market focus.

opportunities.name: TachyonX (formerly Tachyon Accelerator)
opportunities.notes: The successor to the Tachyon accelerator, now run by Consensys Mesh with a focus on AI and Crypto. Admission is on a rolling basis, but application review is paused until fall 2026.

opportunities.name: YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: $100k for 5% equity/token stake for EASY Residency
opportunities.notes: Investment and incubation arm formerly known as Binance Labs. Strong reach into Asia/SEA markets and BNB Chain ecosystem.

opportunities.name: Base ecosystem grants (Coinbase / Base)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: 1-5 ETH for builder grants, 2 ETH weekly for weekly rewards
opportunities.notes: Builder grants for projects on the Base L2 (Coinbase). Support has shifted to a reward-based system via the Base Dashboard and on-chain impact metrics rather than traditional grants.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Eternal (Solana accelerator)
opportunities.notes: Accelerator + venture arm that funds top Solana hackathon teams. Frontier hackathon just ended; next is Fall 2026. 'Eternal' is their rolling application track.

opportunities.name: Draper University Web3 / Crypto programs
opportunities.notes: Founder training and accelerator with recurring crypto/web3 tracks. No specific web3 cohort listed as of last check; confirm on official site.

opportunities.name: Antler (Web3 track)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Pre-seed check (typically equity) after the residency
opportunities.notes: Day-zero venture builder with strong SEA presence (Singapore, Jakarta, etc.). No dedicated 'Web3 track' currently advertised, but still active in the space. Good for solo founders seeking co-founders.

opportunities.name: Founders, Inc. (f.inc)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Space, resources, and investment for some teams
opportunities.notes: San Francisco builder studio/incubator. The 'Off Season' residency program ran in summer 2024; the 2026 schedule is unconfirmed.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Foundation Ecosystem Support Program (ESP)
opportunities.notes: Funds public-goods, infrastructure, research, and tooling for the Ethereum ecosystem. Now emphasizes a Wishlist and RFP-based model for funding. Not for-profit product funding; read the scope before applying.

opportunities.name: Arbitrum Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: ARB grants, milestone-based; tiered amounts (incl. focused funds like Trailblazer)
opportunities.notes: Ecosystem grants for tooling, infra, and apps on Arbitrum (an Ethereum L2). The main Foundation Grant Program is currently inactive (as of July 2026) with a new version 'coming soon,' but several other focused grant programs (audits, gaming, etc.) are active and rolling.

opportunities.name: Optimism Grants (proactive)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP token grants via Collective grant programs
opportunities.notes: Forward-looking grants from the Optimism Collective. Season 9 applications closed in May 2026, and the Grants Council is proposed to be dissolved, suggesting a future change in the grants process.

opportunities.name: Web3 Foundation Grants (Polkadot / Kusama)
opportunities.notes: Funds open-source software and research for Polkadot, Kusama, and Substrate. Application and milestone delivery are managed publicly on GitHub.

opportunities.name: Interchain Foundation Grants (Cosmos)
opportunities.notes: Supports core infrastructure, IBC, and tooling across the Cosmos ecosystem. Funds organizations to develop foundational protocols and advance the Interchain Stack.

opportunities.name: NEAR Foundation Grants / Ecosystem funding
opportunities.notes: Funding for builders on NEAR, now primarily available through performance-based Protocol Rewards and the NEAR Horizon accelerator. Regional dev programs reach Asia/SEA.

opportunities.name: Sui Foundation Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Milestone-based grants for Sui ecosystem projects
opportunities.notes: Grants for Sui ecosystem projects, now focused on structured programs like the Hydropower Fellowship (for early-stage teams) and DeFi Moonshots Program. Standard developer grants are also available.

opportunities.name: Filecoin / Protocol Labs Grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Open grants up to $50k and RFPs; milestone-based
opportunities.notes: Decentralized storage and data ecosystem grants. Proposals are filed and reviewed openly in the devgrants GitHub repo.

opportunities.name: ETHGlobal (hackathon series)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Per-event prize pools (commonly $200K+) across sponsor tracks
opportunities.cadence: multiple in-person + online events per year
opportunities.notes: Flagship Ethereum hackathon series. Next events: ETHGlobal Lisbon (July 24-26, 2026), ETHOnline (Sep 4-16), Tokyo (Sep 25-27), and Mumbai (Nov 6-8). Non-dilutive prizes; strong recruiting/investor surface.

opportunities.name: Colosseum Solana Hackathons (Frontier, etc.)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large prize pools + $250k investment into top teams via Eternal
opportunities.notes: Official Solana Foundation hackathon org. Frontier season just ended; next is Fall 2026 (Sep 28-Nov 2). Prizes are non-dilutive, but winners can raise into the Colosseum/Eternal accelerator (dilutive). Open to SEA founders remotely.

opportunities.name: DoraHacks (global hackathon + BUIDL platform)
opportunities.notes: Global hacker movement and grant platform hosting hackathons for many chains. Frequent SEA and Asia events. Combines prizes with QF grants.

opportunities.name: Polkadot ecosystem hackathons
opportunities.notes: Recurring Polkadot/Substrate hackathons. The Polkadot Solidity Hackathon 2026 ran from Feb-Mar 2026. Check the official events page for the next season.

opportunities.name: Gitcoin Grants & Bounties
opportunities.notes: Public-goods funding via quadratic funding (Gitcoin 3.0 model with seasonal rounds like GG25) plus a bounties marketplace. Best for open-source and community-backed projects.

opportunities.name: Immunefi (security bug bounties)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bug-bounty payouts (up to millions for critical findings)
opportunities.notes: The largest web3 bug-bounty platform. For security researchers earning payouts, and for projects funding their own bounty programs.

opportunities.name: Optimism Retro Funding (RetroPGF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: OP rewards distributed for proven ecosystem impact
opportunities.notes: Pays builders AFTER measurable impact. The standard RetroPGF program is paused for 2026. Other initiatives like the Season 9 Growth Grants have run, but applications are currently closed.

opportunities.name: Drips (continuous retroactive dependency funding)
opportunities.notes: Lets projects stream retroactive funding to the open-source dependencies they rely on. Good for OSS maintainers in the Ethereum ecosystem.

opportunities.name: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship (EPF)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Stipend + mentorship to contribute to Ethereum core protocol
opportunities.notes: Mentorship-driven fellowship for contributing to Ethereum protocol development. Applications for Cohort 7 closed in May 2026.

opportunities.name: Solana ecosystem developer fellowships / bootcamps
opportunities.notes: Solana Foundation runs developer fellowships and regional bootcamps. Active 2026 programs include the Breakpoint Global Fellows Program (for Breakpoint London in Nov) and the Solana Summer School for college students (started June 2026).

opportunities.name: Sky Mavis / Ronin ecosystem grants
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Ecosystem grants for games/apps on Ronin
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-rooted (Sky Mavis / Axie Infinity) gaming-focused L1 ecosystem. Funding is primarily through the automated Proof of Distribution (PoD) reward system and Lightning Grants (up to $20k). Relevant for SEA game and consumer-app builders.

opportunities.name: Kyros Ventures / Coin98 ecosystem programs
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-based research/venture group (Coin98 ecosystem). Active investor and incubator in the SEA region.

opportunities.name: Hashed Emergent (India / SEA)
opportunities.notes: Emerging-markets-focused web3 venture/accelerator (India and Southeast Asia). Good for founders targeting high-growth Asian markets.

opportunities.name: Tribe Accelerator (Singapore)
opportunities.notes: Singapore government-backed blockchain accelerator. Runs flagship Web3 accelerator and specialized programs like the Ignition AI Accelerator with NVIDIA.

opportunities.name: sqrDAO builder programs & bounties (Vietnam / SEA)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Community bounties, hackathon support, and builder programs
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-rooted web3 builder community. Has shifted from bounties to running high-density residency programs (e.g., EMpower Founders Residency) and ecosystem events in Da Nang. Local on-ramp for regional founders.

opportunities.name: Superteam Vietnam (Solana)
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Bounties, grants, and hackathon support for Solana builders
opportunities.notes: Vietnam chapter of Superteam, Solana's talent layer. Highly active with bounties, grants, and ecosystem programs (e.g., Super Vietnam 2026 event). Strong focus on AI and Agentic Engineering in 2026.

opportunities.name: Corelia Academy (Vietnam Web3 education)
opportunities.notes: Campus-embedded Web3 education in Vietnam. Currently running UniHackfest 2026, a national student hackathon, from June to September 2026.

opportunities.name: VBI Academy (Vietnam Blockchain Innovation Academy)
opportunities.notes: Grassroots, free hands-on blockchain/smart-contract dev training. Highly active in 2026 with RWA Summit participation, regulatory collaboration, and developer bootcamps (Cardano, Sui). Builder upskilling, not funding.

opportunities.name: UniHackfest (Vietnam national student hackathon)
opportunities.notes: National student hackathon journey (2026 edition ongoing) organized by Corelia Academy: build real AI & Web3 products over 14 weeks, then pitch. Entry point for Vietnamese university builders.

opportunities.name: RMIT Vietnam FinTech Club / Hack-A-Venture
opportunities.notes: Vietnam's first student-led FinTech club (RMIT Vietnam). The RMIT Hackathon 2026 is scheduled for October 2026.

opportunities.name: HUST BK Fintech Hackday
opportunities.notes: Annual student fintech hackathon by HUST. Runs in multiple seasons per year; Season 12 took place in mid-2026.

opportunities.name: Vietnam Aptos Hackathon (DoraHacks)
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-focused Aptos hackathon hosted on DoraHacks. Concluded in July 2025.

opportunities.name: VietBUIDL Hackathon
opportunities.typical_check_or_prize: Large global prize pool (~$4M reported, 2025 edition)
opportunities.notes: Vietnam-based global blockchain hackathon. Website failed to load on last check; verify whether a current edition is running.
